query:
UPDATE project
                SET owner = $1,
                    name = $2,
                    status = $3,
                    billing_provider = $4,
                    billing_provider_id = $5,
                    claim_token_hash = NULL,
                    user_code = NULL,
                    expires_at = NULL,
                    updated_at = $6
                WHERE id = $7 AND status = $8;
